answer: Proof of Work functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by binding identity to computational expenditure. Each agent must solve a cryptographic puzzle at a specific network vertex to validate its participation. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces an ivory tower of prohibitive electricity costs, making the creation of a vast botnet as unsustainable as chasing a comet. This economic barrier ensures that identity is tied to physical resource consumption rather than mere virtual proliferation.
